name: convo-log
title: Conversation logging
description: Mirror every LLM conversation onto the branch's PR and into a committed JSONL log.
notes: Needs the GitHub CLI, logged in: install from https://cli.github.com (or brew install gh), then gh auth login
Codex CLI (optional, global): in ~/.codex/config.toml set notify = ["python3", "{repo}/.agents/tools/convo-log", "capture", "codex"]
